payload.core_mechanism_summary: Linear scan over split indices i, maintaining prefix mod a, using precomputed suffix mod b, checking for non-leading zero on the right part.
payload.rationale: The solution performs exhaustive search over all possible cut positions, which is a complete search. Among the given subtypes, backtracking is the least inappropriate, though it lacks recursion or undo operations; the iterative loop can be seen as trying successive choices.
